truth: Elsweyr is two old kingdoms sewn together under two moons and pulled apart again. Northern Anequina is a high plateau of red mesas, badland gullies and dry steppe, where clans live by wells, herds and caravans. Southern Pellitine is river valley, sugar-cane floodplain and the Tenmar jungle, rich from plantations and the port trade of Senchal. The Mane at Torval keeps the faith of the moons' path while two kings rule the halves. Since the Void Nights, the Thalmor claim credit for the moons' return and sit in both courts. Moon-sugar enriches the south, feeds the skooma trade, and funds the Renrijra Krin above ancient moon-temples, dragon scours and a necropolis city.

anequina.truth: Anequina is the high plateau of the north: red sandstone mesas over dry steppe, cut by badland gullies where the Renrijra Krin hide. Clans gather at deep wells; Dune's market wheel turns on caravan traffic; Orcrest guards the high mesa road; Riverhold, at the head of the only steady stream, keeps the northern crown's court. Ancient moon-temples stand on the ridges, and the dragon war left a scour of bleached bones on Prowl's Edge. The Thalmor resident counts the wells for the crown's tax, and the rebels poison the ones he counts.

rimmen.truth: Rimmen is the eastern march facing Cyrodiil, where the plateau breaks into sandstone cliffs above the Nibenay border. Rimmen is a city of artisans built on a cliff directly over its own necropolis; Alabaster quarries the pale gypsum stone that dresses the southern temples. Border trade, Imperial grudges and Thalmor customs men make the market rich and nervous. The Baandari peddlers camp at the city's edge, Hakoshae keeps the masked tombs of the old magnates, and every caravan crossing to Cyrodiil pays someone twice.

torval.truth: Torval is the heart of the Khajiit faith, where arched aqueduct water from the escarpment springs meets the first cane fields of the south. Torval is the Mane's city of concentric rings and twin golden domes, where pilgrims climb the processional road at moonrise. Temples of the moons stand on every sandstone knoll around it, the oldest abandoned to dro-m'Athra spirits. The southern crown courts the Mane, the Thalmor court both, and the sugar exchange duty keeps the city fed. It is the place every Khajiit means when they say home.

pellitine.truth: Pellitine is the wet south-west: river terraces and floodplain cane fields running into the Tenmar jungle and the Valenwood gate. Corinthe is the garden city of canals; the plantation towns with Imperial names are Septim-era foundations where Khajiit cutters work for old families. The Tenmar's limestone karst hides moon-temples, the Halls of Colossus and the Temple of Agamanus. Summer floods bring wealth and marsh fever. Smugglers take the sugar downriver by night, and the Green Pact border means Bosmer buy their grain and timber here.

senchal.truth: Senchal is the sugar coast on Topal Bay: a loud, sweet-smelling port stepping down from a hill palace through tiered warehouses to a wide stone quay where everything Elsweyr grows leaves by ship and everything it lacks arrives. Customs men, sugar boilers, sailors, skooma lords and Thalmor envoys share the same crowded streets. Coves along the headlands hide smugglers and wrecks; dragonscours on the bluffs recall the Second Era dragon war. It is rich, crowded and the least trusted city in Elsweyr.
